authenticity_review: The image exhibits high photorealism in texture and lighting but suffers from severe semantic and structural artifacts. The primary defect is the biologically impossible posture of the zebra seated in a human-sized bistro chair; the animal's lower body is occluded or fused with the chair structure, violating anatomical plausibility. Additionally, the croissants display an overly smooth, plastic-like sheen lacking natural pastry micro-texture. Background reflections show minor geometric inconsistencies. While visually striking, the logical impossibility of the central subject significantly reduces authenticity.
key_defects: Spatial inversion: Croissants are in front of chairs, not behind
Semantic/Anatomical artifact: Zebra seated in human chair with fused/occluded lower body
Texture artifact: Croissants have unnatural plastic-like sheen
